references.text: God commands Israel to love the foreigner as themselves and not oppress them, reminding them that they were foreigners in Egypt
Prohibition against mistreating or oppressing the foreigner, based on Israel's own experience as foreigners in Egypt
Reminder not to oppress the foreigner, for Israel knows the foreigner's soul from their time in Egypt
Command to act justly toward the foreigner, reminding Israel that they were slaves in Egypt and the Lord rescued them
Judges are to judge fairly between Israelites and foreigners
The command to love your neighbor as yourself, which is the foundation for loving the foreigner
Jesus speaks about welcoming foreigners as an act done for him personally
Exhortation to show hospitality to foreigners, for some have entertained angels without knowing it
Prophetic exhortation not to do wrong to the foreigner
The foreigners living among Israel are to receive an inheritance share along with the tribes
